line: A field journal that paints itself: translucent washes, dry-brush edges, hand-written notes beside what is painted.
line_cn: 一本自己画自己的手账：透明晕染、干笔飞白，画旁有手写注记。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: One sheet of warm cotton paper under everything; light is unpainted paper.
Translucent washes that darken where they overlap; granulation and blooms at the edges.
A quiet annotation layer: pencil notes and leader lines beside the subject.
Things paint themselves in, structure before detail.
not: Not ink wash: colour, not ink tones.
Not a children's crayon book: no outlines, no cute faces.
Not a photo with a watercolour filter: the paper must show through everywhere.
materials: Cold-press paper texture visible in every wash.
Wet-into-wet skies and water; dry brush for grass, bark, stone.
Pencil underdrawing allowed to show; no black ink outlines.

rules: Three to five hues per scene plus a warm near-black for notes.
Darker means more layers, never a darker pigment on top.
One accent (a vermilion, a rain blue) for one recurring thing.
colour.examplePalette: paper #f3ead8, sage #8ea860, straw #d9c27a, rain blue #3f7fa8, accent #c8442a

type.subtitleFont: serif italic, warm ink at 80 percent
type.placement: centred bottom on paper, no box; notes in a handwriting face beside the subject
rules: Hold notes long enough to read: letters ÷ 15 + 1.5 s.
Painting-in is the main motion; finished things only sway.
Mist and washes drift slowly; nothing jitters.
A page turn or a mist wash is the chapter break.

grammar.note: long lateral dolly over a continuous painted world
to a painted map or diagram

framing: Generous paper margins; one hero subject per view with its note.
forbiddenTransitions: hard video cuts between unrelated pictures

foley: paper brush rustle for each painting-in
sound.ambience: the room where the journal is kept, plus the place being painted
sound.silence: the brush lifted: music out, only paper and room; it frames one painted moment
sound.voice: warm, unhurried documentary read, one line per idea
sound.musicDefault: gentle felt piano and fingerpicked guitar

nativeMoves.name: Painting-in as reveal
nativeMoves.what: A new thing appears stroke by stroke as it enters.
nativeMoves.build: keyframe from a hero frame of the sketch; beats describe washes arriving in order (sky, ground, subject, note).

nativeMoves.name: Palette as data
nativeMoves.what: Sky, ground and background blend by a measured value.
nativeMoves.build: continuous chain with camera truck; each shot's beats name the colour shift and the value it stands for.

nativeMoves.name: Mist erase
nativeMoves.what: The world washes back to paper.
nativeMoves.build: bridge to an end frame of blank paper; next shot a cut.

nativeMoves.name: Specimen and note
nativeMoves.what: One hero object with a hand-written label.
nativeMoves.build: static insert shot; the note is added by the local assembler as a caption, not by the model.

pitfalls.problem: The model paints opaque, gouache-like colour.
pitfalls.fix: Say 'translucent wash, paper showing through' in the beat suffix.

pitfalls.problem: Hand-written text comes out as gibberish.
pitfalls.fix: Never ask the model for notes; add them in the assembler as captions.

pitfalls.problem: Motion turns into a slideshow of stills.
pitfalls.fix: Give each beat a visible painting-in or a drift; keep camera moves slow but present.

look.genre: animated watercolour field journal, lyrical nature documentary
look.palette: translucent washes on warm cotton paper, three to five hues, one small accent
look.camera: slow lateral dollies over a painted world, locked specimen plates
look.lighting: soft daylight read as unpainted paper; no cast shadows harder than a wash

engine.beatSuffix: Everything is translucent watercolour on textured paper, washes bleeding at the edges.

decides: the gradient or list the film walks
structures: a journal over one year, one page per month
anatomy of one object dissected into labelled parts
a recipe painted top to bottom on one tall sheet
openings: a finished painting watched being painted backwards
a close-up of wet pigment spreading
a hand-written question on blank paper
endings: a close-up of one detail as the rest fades to paper
the sheet dries and is filed into a stack
